NCT06365853 uses lubricating eye drops as supportive care to mitigate ocular toxicity during mirvetuximab soravtansine treatment.

NCT03628612 (Enrolling by invitation, completion 2043) is Autolus's long-term safety follow-up of patients already treated in earlier gene-modified T cell studies, so no product is dosed and the row is not one programme.
Taxane is the chemotherapy comparator in NCT04784715 (DESTINY-Breast09, T-DXd with or without pertuzumab versus taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab), not an AstraZeneca product.
CAPOX is the background chemotherapy in NCT07221149 and NCT07221357, where the investigational agent is pumitamig.
ATV is atazanavir, Bristol-Myers Squibb's Reyataz, used as the cobicistat-boosted backbone arm in Gilead's pediatric HIV study NCT02016924, where Gilead's own products are cobicistat and F/TAF.

BR is the background regimen of approved NRTIs in NCT02016924 (Study of Cobicistat-Boosted Atazanavir, Cobicistat-Boosted Darunavir and Emtricitabine/Tenofovir Alafenamide in Children With HIV, ClinicalTrials.gov), not a Gilead product.
DRV is darunavir, Janssen's Prezista, given boosted with Gilead's cobicistat as a backbone arm in NCT02016924 (ClinicalTrials.gov), where Gilead's own products are cobicistat and F/TAF.
LPV/r is lopinavir/ritonavir, AbbVie's Kaletra, one of the third agents given alongside in NCT02016924 (ClinicalTrials.gov), not a Gilead product.
The registry's own description of this NCT02016924 intervention is ATV, DRV and LPV/r as an unspecified third agent (ClinicalTrials.gov), so it names no compound.

HFA-134a is the propellant in the current Ventolin MDI and the comparator in NCT07645248 (A Study to Compare Safety of 4 Weeks Exposure to Propellants HFA-152a and HFA-134a, ClinicalTrials.gov), not a medicine.

HFA-152a is the low-carbon propellant for the reformulated Ventolin MDI and NCT07645248 (not yet recruiting) tests propellant exposure against HFA-134a, not a medicine; the reformulated product is already in the book as Salbutamol HFA-152a (https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/gsk-announces-positive-pivotal-phase-iii-data-for-next-generation-low-carbon-version-of-ventolin-salbutamol-metered-dose-inhaler/).
In NCT06193889 (KYSA-6) this row is the standard conditioning chemotherapy given before Kyverna's CAR-T infusion, a background therapy and not a product under development.
The oocysts are the challenge inoculum in NCT07249463, which tests EDI048 in a Cryptosporidium infection model in healthy adults, not a product in development.

Decitabine appears only as the hypomethylating partner in NCT05201066, a rollover study for patients from prior sabatolimab (MBG453) trials; it is a third-party generic, not a Novartis programme; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/dacogen.html
The only active trial, NCT06784752, tests [177Lu]Lu-DOTA-TATE (Lutathera) in GEP-NET, so octreotide LAR is the comparator or background arm, not a programme.

Ravulizumab is Alexion's Ultomiris (EMA 2019-07-02), listed with eculizumab as a comparator or prior-therapy arm in NCT05133531, a trial of Regeneron's pozelimab plus cemdisiran in PNH; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/ultomiris.html

In NCT06625320, the Phase 3 study of daraxonrasib in previously treated pancreatic cancer, liposomal irinotecan is part of the standard chemotherapy comparator; it is Ipsen's Onivyde (Amass RegulatoryCore, FDA NDA 207793), not a Revolution Medicines product; approval date: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2015/207793Orig1s000ltr.pdf
